authoritative_for: optimizer-side physical scheduler availability observation and Phase-1 physical-pool integrity gating only; this repository file cannot enable, disable, pause, delete, or otherwise mutate platform schedules

required_phase1_pool.non_regression_rule: A required Phase-1 role that becomes physically unavailable must not be silently dropped from the acceptance denominator, logically disabled, restored to base work, or replaced by a new worker. Preserve its base role, exact continuation and optimizer assignment until the platform schedule is explicitly restored or the user explicitly changes the topology requirement.

integrity_gate.reason: The repository-required 14-role Phase-1 proof pool currently has only 13 physically runnable required roles because o_novelty_comparator has no active platform schedule, while repository control still logically enables and assigns that role.
integrity_gate.remaining_physically_runnable_workers_ru: Keep all 13 currently runnable required roles on the existing Phase-1 root and immediately reuse completed/blocked capacity for other non-conflicting Phase-1 leaves. Do not restore base work merely because the missing role blocks aggregate closure.
integrity_gate.missing_role_rule: Preserve o_novelty_comparator base/restoration metadata and Phase-1 assignment as pending physical availability; do not emulate its proof with another role and do not count stale proof as a current physical-execution witness solely to bypass the missing schedule.

scheduler_boundary.optimizer_action: No platform scheduler mutation. Record the exact blocker, keep all runnable roles useful in Phase 1, and recheck physical availability on later optimizer runs.

user_action_blocker.action: Explicitly authorize or perform platform re-enable/restoration of the repository-required o_novelty_comparator scheduled role if the 14-role Phase-1 topology is to remain the acceptance baseline.
user_action_blocker.why_repository_only_cannot_fix: enabled_desired and note control are logical behavior controls only and cannot change physical scheduler state.

rollback.condition: Once an independent platform observation proves the required novelty role is physically runnable again, increment this control revision and set the integrity gate true; do not erase the historical mismatch evidence.
never_rollback_by: lowering the required Phase-1 role count solely because a schedule disappeared
creating a replacement worker without explicit user authorization
claiming repository mutation changed the physical scheduler
